settings.description: HMB Seedance Generation authenticates through the FN AI Broker's one-time browser authorization. Provider API keys remain exclusively on the Broker server. The client performs no secondary usage recording; the Broker is the sole usage, quota, and accounting authority. The node exposes no provider-key input, registration state, quota, or reset data. The permanent Broker access token is protected with Windows DPAPI and never stored in node parameters, outputs, logs, manifests, or release archives. Local reference videos may still use separately scoped Griptape Cloud or least-privilege Volcengine TOS storage credentials.

metadata.description: Native Griptape Agent that remains a stock Standard Library Agent for every request not directly connected from the exact registered HMBPromptLibrary PROMPT_OUT port. That canonical edge validates the user-readable PROMPT_OUT against its atomically paired same-generation private machine snapshot and injects four project rules plus four shot rules at runtime; visible prose is never reverse-parsed. Prompt-only, Prompt-plus-Asset, Prompt-plus-Picker, and Prompt-plus-both remain equally valid. FINAL generator output may apply, summarize, paraphrase, translate, or infer the signed rules over Prompt-selected facts and include every generator-required detail and source name without an output-length or conciseness cap. Only verbatim raw or reconstructable policy-artifact dumps, system instructions, and private Agent objects, memory, validation state, and logs remain blocked. Missing or invalid signed policy fails closed before any native Agent or model call; valid runs retain the downstream model, tools, memory, schema, and native execution path.

Project image asset library using the canonical _hmb_common.py optional Main Type and Sub Type taxonomy. The compact Project Set and reload controls discover direct-child project folders. Scanned images remain unregistered until the Add passport writes a validated project manifest entry with Image Name and Asset ID; Main Type and Sub Type are optional metadata. Optional IMAGE_IMPORT_IN media remains ordinary external media and can be used immediately; Add requires an existing child Asset Folder and copies the image directly there without creating an Asset ID directory. The ordered selection tray keeps ASSET_OUT metadata and Video Generation Out media aligned without imposing a Prompt or other-library prerequisite.

HMB Seedance Generation submits the selected supported model to the authenticated FN AI Broker, refreshes or resumes known Broker jobs without creating replacements, downloads same-origin results with Broker authorization, and never forwards that authorization to external result URLs. Provider API keys remain server-side. The client performs no secondary usage recording; the Broker is the sole usage, quota, and accounting authority. A collapsed AI Broker group below Status shows only connection state, account, and one nonblocking Connect / Refresh action; it exposes no key characters, key-registration control, quota, or reset data. The public media surface accepts up to 9 ordered reference images, up to 3 ordered Picker video references, and up to 3 audio items. Local media publication and output preflight remain bounded and occur before billable submission; successful results publish one local preview and the sole VIDEO_OUT connector.

Canonical goal-first prompt parent with four equal modes: independent Prompt only, Prompt plus Image Asset, Prompt plus Video Picker, and Prompt plus both. While IMAGE_ASSET_IN is connected, only selected Asset-managed rows own active @imageN slots and strictly follow upstream add, remove, and reorder operations so Prompt order stays aligned with Video Generation Out; the Prompt image + button is locked until disconnect because new visible rows must be selected upstream. Native/manual rows remain dormant and return after disconnect; deselected managed settings resume only by exact source_uid. Verified assets bind registered Main Type and Sub Type while Target keeps a Main-Type-aware editable default; unverified or unknown connected values remain local dashboard state and are not serialized into PROMPT_OUT. PICKER_IN synchronizes recognized metadata without creating a required companion or library combination. PROMPT_OUT contains only the user-verifiable Target Generator, Image Source, Image Role, Replacement Binding, and Video Source sections, remains available in every mode, and is the only HMB automation gateway recognized by HMBAgentLibrary.

Maya HMB playblast picker and current-cut video catalog. READ loads Outliner, camera, and timeline metadata without rendering video. Original, Mask (legacy Color Assignment), Depth, and Motion Guide checkboxes are inert selections; only Generate Playblast executes work, and every successful checked result is appended as a new immutable catalog asset instead of replacing a numbered slot. Imported MP4 files join the same history. Video cards use static thumbnails: the centered play button routes playback to the main Preview and toggles play/pause there, while the entire lower information area selects or deselects the card. Selected cards use a thicker, brighter neon outline; delete remains at the upper-right. Dragging selected cards changes their @video1..@videoN order, and metadata-only deletion never leaves the Picker stuck in a busy state. Snapshot and Video share the main viewport: stable Snapshot history is navigated by the left/right controls, the center control alone plays or pauses Video with ▶/Ⅱ, and the redundant local Open action is removed in favor of current-cut Load. Up to ten selected assets publish synchronized Prompt metadata through PICKER_OUT and the same ordered media paths through one VIDEO_OUT list[str] generator connection. Mask remains limited to Maya-authored visible geometry with enabled Color Assignment and Picker eye state; repeated recoloring replaces stale duplicate bindings by Maya UUID or exact DAG path. Depth always derives its surface scope from Maya-authored visibility plus the Picker eye state, independently of Color Assignment. Motion Guide retains the visibility-driven fallback when no Color Assignment exists. Depth v7 and the shared viewport path preserve authored cutout alpha while applying camera-space grayscale or Smooth Preview. Motion Guide v5 adds bounded render-scope eye/eyelid semantic-mesh evidence to Sidecar-v2 final Blend Shape values, controller-value provenance, front-visible surface landmarks, and cached selective visibility checks. Full-detail and Smooth Preview preparation is best-effort, while exact frame-map, raster, H.264, and BT.709 validation remains mandatory.

widgets.name: HMBImageAssetLibraryWidget
widgets.description: Project catalog and image asset browser backed by the canonical _hmb_common.py taxonomy, with compact Project Set/reload icons, manifest-backed Add registration that copies external media directly into a selected child Asset Folder, explicit registered/unregistered thumbnail footers, and a compact draggable @image1-@image50 generator-order tray.

widgets.name: HMBPromptLibraryScopedBindingWidget
widgets.description: Goal-first Prompt dashboard where verified Asset Sub Type remains registered and Target stays editable from a Main-Type default. The image + button is locked only while IMAGE_ASSET_IN is connected and automatically returns after disconnect; video, Picker, Color Pick, VIDEO VFX, and Keep Out data remain optional without downstream prerequisites.

widgets.name: HMBVideoPickerCommandBridgeWidget
widgets.description: Hidden minimal JSON command transport for HMBVideoPickerLibrary; execution commands remain separate from persistent dashboard state.

widgets.name: HMBVideoPickerLibraryWidget
widgets.description: Maya playblast viewport and current-cut asset catalog with static card thumbnails. Each centered card button plays or pauses that asset only in the main Preview; the entire lower information area selects or deselects it. Selected cards have a thicker, brighter neon outline, deletion stays at the upper-right, and dragging selected cards changes the @video1..@videoN order. Metadata-only deletion cannot leave the Picker stuck in a busy state. Snapshot and Video share the viewport: stable Snapshot history uses left/right navigation, the center control alone toggles Video ▶/Ⅱ, and current-cut Load replaces the retired local Open action. Original/Mask/Depth/Motion Guide remain inert selections until the explicit Generate trigger; PICKER_OUT and one ordered VIDEO_OUT list are the only public Picker outputs.
